title: Launcher own-run detached worker test exits 1 after readiness under full-gate load, with its worker output lost
outcome: Launcher own-run detached worker test exits 1 after readiness under full-gate load, with its worker output lost
acceptance: When an own-run detached worker test fails, the failure report carries the inner worker's exit code, stdout and stderr (and its launcher.log/results.json content) before fixture cleanup removes them

The cause of the post-readiness exit 1 in own-run-wait.mjs ('own-run detached worker saves one wait before readiness and stage execution without a mailbox') is identified from that evidence and fixed, or shown to be a product defect and tracked as one; no retry, timeout raise or quarantine is used to make it pass
The test passes in the Windows full gate on the corrected input
